items.title: Article | Ways and Means considers changes to No Surprises Act - POLITICO Pro
items.reason: Congressional consideration of legislative changes to the No Surprises Act directly impacts the regulatory framework governing balance-billing protections and IDR processes that revenue-cycle teams must comply with.
items.summary: The House Ways and Means Committee is considering potential legislative modifications to the No Surprises Act, the federal law governing surprise billing protections and the Independent Dispute Resolution process. While the excerpt does not specify the exact nature of proposed changes, timing, or effective dates, legislative action at this level could alter compliance requirements, IDR procedures, or balance-billing thresholds that directly affect healthcare revenue-cycle operations. Revenue-cycle teams should monitor this development as changes to the statute could necessitate operational adjustments to billing, claims processing, and dispute resolution procedures.
